abstract: A 26-year-old man presented with superior vena caval obstruction. He underwent excision of a malignant teratoma which contained benign hepatic tissue. Three years later he represented with a recurrence and underwent a second resection. Histology of the resected specimen demonstrated hepatocellular carcinoma arising in the hepatic component of the recurrent malignant teratoma intermediate.
abstract_ja: 26歳男性が上大静脈閉塞で受診した。良性の肝組織を含む悪性奇形腫の切除を受けた。3年後に再発し、2回目の切除を受けた。切除標本の組織学的検査で、再発した中間型悪性奇形腫の肝成分から発生した肝細胞癌が認められた。
